Components of Albireo distributed under their own licenses
----------------------------------------------------------

dlib and Dlib-Transformer-extensions    Boost Software License 1.0
Mbed TLS 3.6                            Apache License 2.0
cpp-httplib                             MIT License
SQLite                                  Public domain
zlib                                    zlib License
marked (web application)                MIT License
DOMPurify (web application)             Apache License 2.0 or Mozilla Public License 2.0
highlight.js (web application)          BSD 3-Clause License
KaTeX (web application)                 MIT License
PDF.js (web application)                Apache License 2.0
Swagger UI (interface documentation)    Apache License 2.0

The engines for the NPU and the graphics processors, when an installation carries
them, include the runtime libraries of their devices:

OpenVINO and oneTBB (Intel NPU and GPU)  Apache License 2.0
CUDA runtime, cuBLAS, cuDNN (NVIDIA)     NVIDIA license agreements for
                                         redistributable components
Microsoft Visual C++ runtime             Microsoft Visual Studio license terms for
                                         distributable code

The texts of these licenses are installed with Albireo, in the folders of the
components (web\vendor, web\docs) and in licenses\.

Models
------

Albireo downloads language models from the catalog its publisher maintains, or
imports the files the user provides.  Each model is distributed under the license
of its authors, which the Models window of Albireo shows; using a model means
accepting its license.
